$comment: Entry schema for contributes.walkthroughs (declarative and process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_walkthroughs.go. Each step has exactly one of markdown (a package-relative .md file) or text (plain multi-line text); markdownLocalized is allowed only with markdown. Markdown files are UTF-8 (a BOM is stripped), at most {{limits.markdownMaxBytes}} bytes, without control, bidirectional override or zero-width characters; the host renders them with raw HTML escaped, inline images dropped (shown as their alt text) and only http(s) links, opened in the system browser. Step images are package .svg or .png files (svgsafe allowlist, PNG re-encoded, at most {{limits.pngMaxDimension}} px) and need imageAlt. Asset files live under walkthroughs/, media/ or assets/. command is allowed only for runtime.type process and must be one of the plugin's own contributes.commands; it runs through the normal command path with its risk confirmation. At most one walkthrough per plugin may be featured. Walkthroughs never open automatically.
description: Walkthroughs: short step-by-step guides the user opens from the plugin details drawer or the dashboard's Get started card.

featured.description: Offer this walkthrough on the dashboard's Get started card (at most one per plugin).

markdownLocalized.description: Locale tag → package-relative .md file; requires markdown.

command.description: One of this plugin's contributes.commands ids (process plugins only).
